description: OS release identity and the Sec-CH-UA-Platform-Version client hint Chromium derives from it. Windows platform versions are UniversalApiContract versions, not build numbers; macOS platform versions are OS version triples; Chromium emits an empty platform version on Linux.
label: os_release

options.note: Windows 11 builds: 22000 (21H2), 22621 (22H2), 22631 (23H2), 26100 (24H2) -- the Version enum and OSInfo::MajorMinorBuildToVersion in base/win/windows_version.h. platformVersion is NOT the build number: Chromium builds the Windows Sec-CH-UA-Platform-Version from the Windows.Foundation.UniversalApiContract REG_DWORD under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsRuntime\WellKnownContracts as "HIWORD.LOWORD.0", falling back to kHighestKnownUniversalApiContractVersion = 19 when the key is unreadable (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc, GetUniversalApiContractVersion / GetWindowsPlatformVersion). 19.0.0 is measured on the Windows 11 reference host. The build number is not page-observable at all -- the UA OS token is "Windows NT 10.0" for every Windows 10 and 11 release -- so splitting 22H2/23H2/24H2 into separate options would buy no entropy and would multiply unmeasured contract claims. One Windows 11 option is the honest shape.

AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. Windows 11 22H2/23H2 (builds 22621/22631). platformVersion is the UniversalApiContract version Chromium reads out of HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsRuntime\WellKnownContracts and formats as "HIWORD.LOWORD.0" (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc, GetUniversalApiContractVersion), never the build number. 19.0.0 is measured on the reference host and is also Chromium's kHighestKnownUniversalApiContractVersion, i.e. 24H2 and later. 15 is the only other contract value with a citable source, so it is the only other Windows 11 option offered; the 16/17/18 range exists in the SDK history but I found no source that maps it to a serviced Windows release, and an unsourced registry value is exactly the falsifiable kind of guess this catalogue refuses.
options.source: Microsoft Learn, Windows app versioning overview (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/get-started/versioning-overview): an API introduced between build 22621 and build 26100 is guarded with IsApiContractPresent("Windows.Foundation.UniversalApiContract", 15), so contract 15 is the contract present from Windows 11 22H2 (build 22621) until 24H2 raises it

options.note: Windows 10 builds: 19041 (20H1), 19042 (20H2), 19043 (21H1), 19044 (21H2), 19045 (22H2) -- the Version enum and OSInfo::MajorMinorBuildToVersion in base/win/windows_version.h. 22H2 (19045) is the only Windows 10 release still serviced. AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the contract major 10 for Windows 10 2004 and later is Microsoft SDK release history, not a capture and not derivable from Chromium source. Chromium reads the value out of the registry (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc), and the only mapping Chromium source does give is GetPreRS5UniversalApiContractVersion, which covers contract 1..6 for Windows 10 1507, 1511, 1607, 1703, 1709 and 1803 only -- all long out of service and all near-zero prevalence, so none are offered. The build number itself is not page-observable; only this contract string is.

GetPlatformVersion returns base::SysInfo::OperatingSystemVersionNumbers formatted "%d.%d.%d" on macOS (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc), so the client hint is the real OS version triple. The UA string's OS token is frozen at "Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7" and carries no OS entropy.

GetPlatformVersion returns base::SysInfo::OperatingSystemVersionNumbers formatted "%d.%d.%d" on macOS (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc), so the client hint is the real OS version triple. The UA string's OS token is frozen at "Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7" and carries no OS entropy. AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the 26.5.0 triple is release history, not a capture. Only 26.6.2 is measured here.

GetPlatformVersion returns base::SysInfo::OperatingSystemVersionNumbers formatted "%d.%d.%d" on macOS (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc), so the client hint is the real OS version triple. The UA string's OS token is frozen at "Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7" and carries no OS entropy. AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the 15.7.2 triple is release history, not a capture.

GetPlatformVersion returns std::string() under BUILDFLAG(IS_LINUX) (components/embedder_support/user_agent_utils.cc), so the Linux platform version is empty by construction and carries no entropy. Measured empty on both Linux reference hosts.
